tasks.title: Bypass Mandatory validatePresentation for In-Memory Lifecycles & Slide Imports
tasks.description: Remove blocking validatePresentation invocations from createBlank(), load(), shape mutations (addShape), and importSlideFrom(). Allow agile in-memory operations and lazy/manual validation via ppt.validatePresentation() without runtime execution halts.

tasks.title: Fix Positional Insertion in importSlideFrom
tasks.description: Fix importSlideFrom(sourcePpt, sourceIndex, atPosition) so it accurately inserts cloned slides at the specified 1-based atPosition index. Adjust <p:sldIdLst> ordering in ppt/presentation.xml, normalize clamped boundaries ([1, slideCount + 1]), shift subsequent slide references forward, and ensure relationship IDs map without collisions.
deliverables: src/managers/SlideManager.js (importSlideFrom position targeting and slide list splicing)

tasks.title: Fix and Wire addSection Engine (<p14:sectionLst>)
tasks.description: Fix ppt.addSection(name, startSlideIndex). Ensure presentation extension lists correctly initialize or append to <p14:sectionLst xmlns:p14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/powerpoint/2010/main"> in ppt/presentation.xml, generate valid UUIDs (id="{...}"), map child slide IDs (<p14:sldIdLst>), and register required XML namespaces.

tasks.title: Implement Global Percentage-Based Slide Coordinate System
tasks.description: Implement percentage coordinates across all shape, table, text, chart, and media positioning APIs. Support string percentages ('0%', '100%') and normalized numeric percentages (0 to 100), mapped against slide canvas dimensions (from <p:sldSz>): (0, 0) = Top-Left, (100, 0) = Bottom-Left, (0, 100) = Top-Right, (100, 100) = Bottom-Right, converting seamlessly to English Metric Units (EMUs).

tasks.title: Comprehensive Metadata & Coordinate Extraction in getSlides & getSlide
tasks.description: Upgrade getSlides() and getSlide(index) to parse DrawingML/PresentationML and extract comprehensive metadata for all slide elements: placeholders, titles, text runs, media/images, tables, charts, animations, transitions, notes, dimensions, layout properties, and explicit (x, y, width, height) positions in pixels and EMUs.

tasks.title: Update Documentation, Showcase & .agent Workspace Memory
tasks.description: Update docs-site/src/data/apiReference.json, features.json, README.md, showcase scripts, and .agent files (.agent/rules/features.md, .agent/project_summary.md) reflecting non-blocking validation, percentage coordinates, fixed section additions, and metadata extraction schemas.
